To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

it is possible identify the physical parameters of the sandwich beam using the measured FRF and optimization methods, such as Genetic Algorithms, Differential Evolution and Particle Swarm Optimization, and the results are very similar to the numeric FRF obtained with the Finite Element Method.
the optimization of physical parameters using GA, PSO and DE methods can be applied successfully to the identification of Young‟s Modulus and the Loss Factor of sandwich beams.

1) the proposed method is effective for the determination of the physical parameters of sandwich beams; 2) the proposed method can be used to determine the physical parameters of the sandwich beam with a high accuracy; 3) the proposed method allows the use of measured and numeric frequency responses functions (FRF) in the optimization process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new methodology to estimate physical parameters of sandwich beams.
the development of an efficient methodology for identification of physical parameters of a beam made of sandwich structure.
the identification of the physical properties of sandwich beams using measured FRFs and parametric optimization of the physical parameters of the sandwich beam.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
it is possible determine the physical properties of sandwich beam with the optimization methods, and it is possible to estimate the physical properties of materials of sandwich beam with FRFs.
the proposed optimization methods are efficient to estimate the physical parameters of sandwich beams.
the parametric optimization methods are effective for the estimation of physical parameters of sandwich beams.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the parametric optimization of the physical parameters of the sandwich beam is a good method to determine them.
the optimization of physical properties of sandwich beams is a viable alternative to determine the physical parameters of the sandwich beam.
the optimization methods are very effective for the identification of physical parameters of a structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the GA method is the best optimization method to identify the physical parameters.
we are capable to estimate physical properties of a sandwich beam using measured FRFs with three optimization methods.
the optimization methods are effective to determine the physical parameters of the sandwich beam.
